==Problem==
The first AMC <math>8</math> was given in <math>1985</math> and it has been given annually since that time. Samantha turned <math>12</math> years old the year that she took the seventh AMC <math>8</math>. In what year was Samantha born?

<math>\textbf{(A) }1979\qquad\textbf{(B) }1980\qquad\textbf{(C) }1981\qquad\textbf{(D) }1982\qquad \textbf{(E) }1983</math>

==Solution 1==
The seventh AMC 8 would have been given in <imath>1991</imath>. If Samantha was 12 then, that means she was born 12 years ago, so she was born in <imath>1991-12=1979</imath>.

Our answer is <imath>\boxed{(\text{A})1979}</imath>

corrections made by DrDominic

==Solution 2==
Since she was 12 when she took the seventh AMC 8, she should be <imath>12-6=6</imath> years old when the first AMC 8 occurred. Therefore, she was born or was 'age 0' in <imath>1985-6=\boxed{\left(\text{A}\right)1979}</imath>
~SweetMango77
